note: Recast from the original description of Holmgren (1906), original in German; it covers the soldier and the worker; the alate was described later by Emerson (1925) from Kartabo material (that paper also records head length 1.07 mm, head width 0.87—0.90 mm, eye diameter 0.40 mm, pronotum 0.50×0.73—0.76 mm, hind tibia 1.37—1.40 mm, and a queen with body length 18 mm and abdomen width 4 mm), but that supplementary description is not adopted here. Habitat: loose soil in primary forest, excavating its own galleries.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements: body length 3.9 mm, head length 1.35 mm, head width 0.81 mm. Head straw yellow, the frontal projection (nasus) dark reddish brown, finely hairy and with several long setae; the edges between the thoracic segments with long pale whitish yellow hairs; abdominal sclerites hairy, the ventral posterior margin with several long setae, greyish white with small white spots, the grey-brown gut contents showing through. Head roundly oval, with a conical frontal projection; the frontal section weakly and evenly convex; transverse suture distinct. Antenna 11 segments; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 equal in length to segment 3. Anterior margin of the pronotum short and upturned. Abdomen slightly wider than the head, widest anteriorly.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Measurements: body length 4 mm, head length 0.9 mm, head width 0.72 mm. Head pale yellowish white, body greyish white, the grey-brown gut contents showing through the abdomen. Head, thorax and abdominal sclerites hairy, the head and the ventral sclerites with some long setae in addition. Head roundly pentagonal, widest in front of the antennae; longitudinal suture indistinct, transverse suture only faintly indicated; fontanelle absent; clypeus rather narrow and raised, with a groove in the middle of the base, the apex indistinct; labrum short and rather wide; right mandible with a reduced middle tooth on the posterior margin of the apical tooth, left mandible with a basal tooth almost square and slightly directed backwards. Antenna 13 segments, segment 3 very small, segment 2 about equal to, or slightly shorter than, segments 3 and 4 together.
